_comment: Made by tools/parts/make_parts.py, so change the parts there. Sizes and connector spots are in the fine unit, a twentieth of a stud (see scripts/parts/grid.gd).

b_frame_sport.name: Sports bike frame
b_frame_sport.about: A sports bike frame with a twin in it, and the seat and swingarm. Put a fork on the front, a fairing too if you like, and wheels on both ends.

b_frame_dirt.name: Dirt bike frame
b_frame_dirt.about: A dirt bike frame, light, with a little single and a tall seat. Put a fork on the front and wheels on both ends.

b_frame_cruiser.name: Cruiser frame
b_frame_cruiser.about: A long, low cruiser frame with a big twin. Put a fork on the front and wheels on both ends.

b_frame_scooter.name: Scooter frame
b_frame_scooter.about: A scooter with an electric motor under the seat and a floor for your feet. Put the scooter fork on the front and small wheels on both ends.

b_frame_trike.name: Trike frame
b_frame_trike.about: A trike frame with an axle across the back for two wheels. Put a fork on the front and wheels on all three.

b_moto_fork.name: Motorbike fork
b_moto_fork.about: A front fork with the bars on top, for a motorbike frame. The bars and the front wheel turn together.

b_moto_fork_dirt.name: Dirt bike fork
b_moto_fork_dirt.about: A dirt bike's fork with high bars and a mudguard up high over the wheel.

b_moto_fork_scooter.name: Scooter fork
b_moto_fork_scooter.about: A short fork with bars and a lamp, for the scooter frame and small wheels.

s_seat.name: Driver's seat
s_seat.about: Sits the driver upright. They see everything and steer quickly, but a lot of them sticks up into the wind.

s_bucket_seat.name: Bucket seat
s_bucket_seat.about: Sits the driver lower and leaning back a little. Less of them catches the wind, and the kart sits lower.

s_racing_seat.name: Racing seat
s_racing_seat.about: Hugs the driver so they can steer their best, a little lower and leaning back a little.

s_lay_down_seat.name: Lay-down seat
s_lay_down_seat.about: The driver lies nearly flat, like on a luge. Hardly any of them is in the wind, but it's harder to steer lying down.

w_drag_slick.name: Dragster slick
w_drag_slick.about: A huge soft slick for the back of a dragster. It grips the road like nothing else, and is hopeless on grass.

w_drag_front.name: Dragster front wheel
w_drag_front.about: Tiny and thin, for the front of a dragster. It rolls easily but barely grips.

w_monster.name: Monster truck wheel
w_monster.about: Huge, with deep tread. It climbs over anything, but lifts the truck up high where it rolls in corners.

w_truck.name: Truck tire
w_truck.about: A chunky knobbly tire for trucks. Good on dirt and grass, a little slow on the road.

w_quad.name: Quad wheel
w_quad.about: Small, fat and knobbly, for quads. It grips well on dirt.

e_blower_v8.name: Blower V8
e_blower_v8.about: A V8 with a blower on top. A huge shove off the line and lots of power, but it's heavy.

b_quad_frame.name: Quad frame
b_quad_frame.about: A quad's frame with the engine and saddle in it and an axle across each end. Put quad wheels on the ends of the axles, quad bars on the post and fenders over the wheels.

b_chopper_fork.name: Chopper fork
b_chopper_fork.about: A long raked fork with tall bars, for a cruiser or trike frame. The frame goes on further back than on the motorbike fork.

b_trike_body.name: Chopper trike body
b_trike_body.about: A wide body for the back of the trike frame, over the frame's tail and between the back wheels, with studs on top. It hangs on the back axle.

b_quad_bars.name: Quad bars
b_quad_bars.about: Short bars for a quad, on the post in front of its saddle.

p_bonnet_4x4_lime_stripe.name: Smooth bonnet 4×4 with a lime stripe

p_arch_2x6_yellow_stripe.name: Smooth wheel arch 2×6 with a yellow stripe

p_arch_2x6_teal_stripe.name: Smooth wheel arch 2×6 with a teal stripe

p_bonnet_4x4_red_stripe.name: Low bonnet 4×4 with a red stripe

w_scrambler.name: Scrambler wheel
w_scrambler.about: A knobbly wheel for a dirt bike, smaller than a motorbike wheel. Good on grass and gravel.

w_scooter_small.name: Little scooter wheel
w_scooter_small.about: A little fat wheel for scooters and little trikes.

b_fork_sport.name: Sports fork
b_fork_sport.about: A short sports fork with low bars, for small wheels on the superbike frame.

b_frame_superbike.name: Superbike frame
b_frame_superbike.about: A low superbike frame with a twin in it, the seat and swingarm. Put the sports fork and small wheels on it and the fairings over it.

b_body_superbike.name: Superbike bodywork
b_body_superbike.about: The superbike's tank, belly pan and tail in one, with a stripe and a number.

b_nose_superbike.name: Superbike fairing
b_nose_superbike.about: A pointed front fairing with a screen and a headlight, for the superbike frame.

b_frame_reverse_trike.name: Reverse trike frame
b_frame_reverse_trike.about: A reverse trike's frame with a twin under the saddle, an axle across the front for two wheels with clips for wings, a swingarm for one back wheel and a post for quad bars.

b_nose_reverse_trike.name: Reverse trike nose
b_nose_reverse_trike.about: A wide rounded nose with a stripe and two headlights, between the front wheels of the reverse trike.

b_tail_reverse_trike.name: Reverse trike tail
b_tail_reverse_trike.about: A tail over the reverse trike's back wheel, with a tail light.

b_fork_dirt_small.name: Scrambler fork
b_fork_dirt_small.about: A dirt bike fork with tall bars, a mudguard up high and a number plate, for the scrambler frame.

b_fork_scooter_small.name: Little scooter fork
b_fork_scooter_small.about: A scooter's front end: a mudguard round the wheel, the headset with its lamp and the bars, for little wheels.

b_fork_chopper_long.name: Long chopper fork
b_fork_chopper_long.about: A long raked fork with high bars for a chopper or chopper trike frame, on a small front wheel.

b_frame_scrambler.name: Scrambler frame
b_frame_scrambler.about: A tall dirt bike frame with a single in it, a long flat seat and the swingarm. Put the scrambler fork and knobbly wheels on it.

b_body_scrambler.name: Scrambler bodywork
b_body_scrambler.about: The scrambler's tank, radiator scoops, number boards and back mudguard in one.

b_frame_scooter_small.name: Little scooter frame
b_frame_scooter_small.about: A scooter's frame, the floor and an electric motor driving the back wheel. Put the little scooter fork on the front, the scooter bodywork over it and little wheels on both ends.

b_frame_delta_trike.name: Little trike frame
b_frame_delta_trike.about: A little trike's frame with a scooter's front, a saddle on a post, a deck for a box and an axle across the back for two little wheels.

b_body_scooter.name: Scooter bodywork
b_body_scooter.about: A scooter's apron, floor and rounded back with the seat on top, for the little scooter frame.

b_body_delta_trike.name: Little trike bodywork
b_body_delta_trike.about: A little trike's apron, floor, a stand for its saddle and mudguards over the back wheels.

b_frame_chopper_long.name: Long chopper frame
b_frame_chopper_long.about: A long, low chopper frame with a big V twin, the seat low down and a pad behind it for a sissy bar. Put the long chopper fork on the front and a fat wheel at the back.

b_frame_chopper_trike.name: Chopper trike frame
b_frame_chopper_trike.about: A chopper trike's frame with a big V twin, the seat low down, a pad for a sissy bar and a deck over an axle across the back for two wheels.

b_tank_chopper.name: Chopper tank
b_tank_chopper.about: A teardrop tank with a stripe down the top, for a chopper frame.

b_fender_chopper.name: Chopper mudguard
b_fender_chopper.about: A long rounded mudguard over a chopper's fat back wheel, on chrome stays.

b_body_chopper_trike.name: Smooth chopper trike body
b_body_chopper_trike.about: A chopper trike's smooth rounded body 3×4 over the back axle.

b_wing_trike_left.name: Trike wing left
b_wing_trike_left.about: A small wing over a front wheel of the reverse trike, on an upright that turns with the wheel.

b_wing_trike_right.name: Trike wing right
b_wing_trike_right.about: A small wing over a front wheel of the reverse trike, on an upright that turns with the wheel.

b_box_delta_trike.name: Little trike box
b_box_delta_trike.about: A rounded box with a lid, for the deck on the back of the little trike.

b_frame_quad_zipper.name: Sport quad frame
b_frame_quad_zipper.about: A sport quad's frame with the engine and saddle on it and an axle across each end for quad wheels. Put its bodies over the wheels.

b_quad_front_zipper.name: Sport quad front
b_quad_front_zipper.about: A sport quad's front body over both front wheels, with lamps, a stripe and the tank.

b_quad_back_zipper.name: Sport quad back
b_quad_back_zipper.about: A sport quad's back body over both back wheels, with studs on top and tail lights.

b_frame_quad_mudlark.name: Mud quad frame
b_frame_quad_mudlark.about: A tall mud quad's frame with the engine and saddle on it and an axle across each end for big knobbly wheels. Put its bodies over the wheels.

b_quad_front_mudlark.name: Mud quad front
b_quad_front_mudlark.about: A mud quad's front body over both front wheels, with lamps, a rack and the tank.

b_quad_back_mudlark.name: Mud quad back
b_quad_back_mudlark.about: A mud quad's back body over both back wheels, with a rack and a tow hitch.

b_frame_quad_flat_track.name: Racing quad frame
b_frame_quad_flat_track.about: A low racing quad's frame with the engine and saddle on it and an axle across each end. Put its bodies over the wheels.

b_quad_front_flat_track.name: Racing quad front
b_quad_front_flat_track.about: A racing quad's low front body over both front wheels, with lamps, a stripe and the tank.

b_quad_back_flat_track.name: Racing quad back
b_quad_back_flat_track.about: A racing quad's low back body over both back wheels, with studs on top and tail lights.
